name: social_network

scripts.certs: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -sha256 -days 365 -subj /CN=localhost -addext subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1 -keyout certs/key.pem -out certs/cert.pem

description: API My Social Networks (événements, groupes, discussions, albums, sondages, billetterie)
